title: Brownie Bake Sale

serves.summary: The learner cuts brownie pans to find how many unit-fraction servings are in whole pans (2 ÷ 1/3 = 6) and how much of the whole pan one friend gets when a leftover unit fraction is shared (1/3 ÷ 4 = 1/12), which shows division with unit fractions.

request.objective: Divide a whole number by a unit fraction and a unit fraction by a whole number using a visual model, and explain the quotient (2 ÷ 1/3 = 6 because each whole has 3 thirds; 1/3 ÷ 4 = 1/12 of the whole) (5.NF.B.7).

problems.ask: Each serving is 1/3 of a pan. How many servings can we sell from 2 pans?
Each serving is 1/4 of a pan. How many servings are in 3 pans? Two pans are still under foil.
problems.goal: The sign says 12: 4 servings in each pan, 3 pans.

problems.ask: 1/3 of the pan is left. 4 friends share it equally. How much of the whole pan does each friend get?
1/2 of the pan is left. 3 friends share it equally. How much of the whole pan does each friend get?
problems.goal: The sign says 1/6: 1/2 ÷ 3 = 1/6, with no guide lines on the empty pan.

problems.ask: Each serving is 1/5 of a pan. All 4 pans are under foil. How many servings can we sell?
